title: Non-rigid disk pseudo-rotations in $C^1$ and $C^{1,β}$
summary: We construct area-preserving irrational pseudo-rotations of the closed disk that fail to be $C^0$-rigid. For every Brjuno rotation number we obtain $C^1$ examples, and they may be chosen arbitrarily $C^1$-close to the rigid rotation with the same rotation number. For $0<β<1$, a weighted Brjuno condition gives $C^{1,β}$ examples that are arbitrarily close in the $C^{1,β}$ topology; this weighted range contains every rotation number with denominator-growth exponent strictly smaller than $1/β$ and also some numbers at the critical exponent.
